Both files score 100 on the Strata audit with no findings. The screen is complete:

- **`src/screens/Screen.tsx`** — lists six mock scheduled payments (payee, amount, next date, frequency, status) in a `DataTable` inside a `Card`. Each row has a `Menu` with Pause/Resume, Edit and Cancel. Edit opens a controlled `Dialog` (amount, date, frequency); Cancel opens a danger `AlertDialog` that says the action can't be undone and removes the row on confirm — there's no way to bring it back. "Schedule a payment" is a header `Button` that opens a `Dialog` form to add a new payment. Uses `Amount`, `Badge` (status variant, word + tone, never colour alone), `DatePicker`, `Select`, `TextField`, `toast` confirmations, and locale-aware date formatting via `useLocale`.
- **`src/screens/Screen.module.css`** — layout only, all `var(--strata-*)` tokens, logical properties (`inline-size`, `margin-inline`, etc.), no brand or hex values.

No native `<button>/<input>/<select>/<table>`, no deprecated APIs (`tone="danger"`, not `variant="danger"`), all icon-only buttons have `aria-label`, nothing brand-specific in the code — it should render correctly across tenants, schemes and RTL locales via the existing `ThemeScope` in `main.tsx`.
